description: React component for team access settings tab, managing allowed domains, open invite options, and save/cancel actions.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type combining Redux props and own props for the AccessTab component.

methods.name: generateAllowedDomainOptions
methods.description: Generates an array of trimmed domain strings from a comma-separated string or single domain.

methods.name: AccessTab
methods.description: Main React functional component for team access tab, handling state and user interactions.

methods.name: handleAllowedDomainsSubmit
methods.description: Submits allowed domains to server via patchTeam action.

methods.name: handleOpenInviteSubmit
methods.description: Submits open invite setting to server via patchTeam action.

methods.name: updateOpenInvite
methods.description: Updates open invite setting and marks unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets save panel state and error flags.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Reverts changes to initial team settings.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves all changes, updates save panel state, and resets unsaved changes flag.
